title: What is a Pod?
description: A group of one or more containers, with shared storage and network resources, and a specification for how to run the containers.

title: What are the smallest deployable units in Kubernetes?
description: Pods are the smallest deployable units of computing that you can create and manage in Kubernetes.

title: What types of containers can a Pod contain?
description: A Pod can contain application containers, init containers (which run during startup), and ephemeral containers (which can be injected for debugging a running Pod).

title: Pod concept comparison
description: A Pod is similar to a set of containers with shared namespaces and shared filesystem volumes.
